definitions.gloss: water pipe; water main; water conduit
definitions.explanation: A pipe that carries water from one place to another, especially a large pipe in a water-supply system.

examples.japanese: {送水管|そうすいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破裂|はれつ}→破裂：10058_haretsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{送水管|そうすいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: A thick water main runs underground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{送水管|そうすいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{替|か}え⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Replacement work was carried out on the aging water mains.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{送水|そうすい}→送水：24011_sousui⟧ (water conveyance) + ⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧ (pipe, tube). Refers to supply pipes in waterworks and buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送水管|そうすいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破裂|はれつ}→破裂：10058_haretsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for a water main to burst
- {送水管|そうすいかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: water-main work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧: water pipe — the everyday word for household water pipes
- ⟦{配管|はいかん}→配管：07495_haikan⟧: piping, plumbing — the pipes and the work of laying them
